name: You were mentioned
description: Tells someone their name came up in a comment or document, and carries the sentence it came up in so the mention can be judged without opening anything.

origin.note: Design: transcript — the quoted sentence set large in Palatino behind an accent rule, the place it was said whispered above it, one rounded action.

subject: {{ author_name }} mentioned you

author_name.description: Who wrote the mention. A mention from a stranger and a mention from your manager are different emails, and only the name tells them apart.

mention_text.description: The sentence the recipient's name appeared in, verbatim. This is the entire value of the message and it doubles as the preheader, so send the real words rather than a summary.
mention_text.example: Can we get Ada to sign off the migration plan before Thursday? She wrote the original importer.

mention_location.description: Where it was said, in the reader's own vocabulary — a document title, a channel, a card. Without it a quotation is just a fragment.
mention_location.example: Q3 roadmap planning, in the Product space

mention_time.description: When it was written, in the recipient's timezone if you know it. Attached to the quotation rather than the headline, because it dates the words and not the email.

action_label.description: Label on the only button. It should promise the thread, not the product.

action_url.description: Deep link to the comment itself, anchored so the reader lands on the quoted line rather than the top of a long document.

context_note.description: The one thing a mention email always has to say: what happens if they hit reply. Most people will try it.
context_note.default: Replying to this email won't post anything. Use the link above to answer where the conversation is.

notification_settings_url.description: Where mention alerts get turned down or batched. Mentions are the notification people mute first, so make muting easy rather than making it a search.

notification_settings_label.description: Wording of that link. Name the frequency, not the settings screen.
notification_settings_label.default: Change how often you get these
